title: Can Machines Resonate with Humans? Evaluating the Emotional and Empathic Comprehension of LMs

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing human inter-annotator agreement and LLM performance on empathic similarity tasks between an English dataset and a newly constructed Urdu dataset to evaluate the impact of cultural background on empathy comprehension.
Evaluating LLM zero-shot performance on empathic similarity tasks using story pairs written in English versus Roman Urdu to investigate how language affects model estimations of empathy.
